subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw make `append?: boolean` part of the built-in `write` tool and observable write-event/backend contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows?
rationale: The data-loss need and implementation path are well supported, but the permanent model-facing write API and session-admission alias behavior are maintainer-owned compatibility decisions.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land this PR after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean`, optional `appendFile`, and session-alias admission behavior as the supported contract.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement using a string `mode` field or a dedicated append tool if maintainers want a different long-term API shape.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and reject this PR if prompt/docs/workaround guidance remains the preferred product direction for now.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land this PR after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean`, optional `appendFile`, and session-alias admission behavior as the supported contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available history signal across the agent runtime API and session/tool boundary decisions touched by this PR.
